verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents creating campaigns from an external AI chat and offers a Marketing API with a send endpoint, so an agent can author campaigns. Nothing documents segment targeting, scheduling, or a human-approval queue, and the send endpoint states non-RSS campaigns 'will send immediately.' missing for 10: documented segment targeting for agent-drafted campaigns, a schedule/queue API for non-RSS campaigns, a human approval gate before send, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: Create campaigns with the AI you already use. Without leaving the chat.
Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.
